abstract: This paper investigates how misclassification affects the estimation of peer effects in linear-in-means (LIM) models. We formally show that the peer effect estimate is biased by an ”own effect” due to error in the group average and a smearing effect due to misclassification in the individual regressor. The direction of the total bias depends on how misclassification is distributed across groups. We develop a simple heuristic based on the ratio of the estimated peer effect to the estimated individual effect to help researchers identify the likely direction of the total bias. We verify the theoretical predictions in the setting of peer effects of students with learning disabilities on other students’ performance.
title: Misclassification in linear-in-means models: Theory and application to peer effects estimation

abstract: This paper investigates the relation between executive compensation and corporate tax policies, with a focus on the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 (TCJA). Using a pay-performance sensitivity framework, we analyze the differing compensation rewards associated with domestic and foreign pre-tax incomes. Our findings reveal that, before the TCJA, executives received significantly higher rewards for foreign income, encouraging them to shift income abroad. The TCJA reduced this disparity, bringing rewards for domestic and foreign income into closer alignment. A cross-sectional analysis shows that firms assessing CEO performance based on after-tax income exhibit greater sensitivity to changes in tax policy, establishing the presence of a tax mechanism. Additional tests eliminate alternative nontax explanations related to protectionist trade policies and changes in foreign market growth opportunities. These results highlight the significant impact of executive incentives on corporate tax behavior and the effectiveness of tax policy reforms.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了高管薪酬与企业税收政策之间的关系，特别聚焦于2017年的《减税与就业法案》（TCJA）。通过运用薪酬-绩效敏感性框架，我们分析了国内外税前收入所对应的不同薪酬奖励。研究发现，在TCJA实施前，高管因外国收入获得的奖励显著更高，这鼓励他们将收入转移至海外。TCJA缩小了这一差距，使国内外收入的奖励趋于一致。截面分析显示，基于税后收入评估CEO绩效的企业，对税收政策变化更为敏感，从而证实了税收机制的存在。额外的检验排除了与保护主义贸易政策及外国市场增长机会变化相关的非税收替代解释。这些结果凸显了高管激励对企业税收行为的重大影响，以及税收政策改革的有效性。
title: Pay for(eign) performance: CEO pay incentives for foreign tax savings
title_zh: 为（外国）绩效付费：CEO薪酬激励与外国税收节省

abstract: In this paper, we propose incorporating both self‐fundamentals, defined as the fundamentals of two economies in one currency pair, and cross‐fundamentals, defined as the fundamentals of other major economies, to forecast exchange rates in line with the theory of “third‐country effects” of Berg and Mark (2015). We utilize the Mallows model averaging method proposed in Hansen (2007) to optimally combine the predictions provided by fundamental submodels. We find that our approach significantly outperforms the random walk and the alternatives for one‐month‐ahead predictions and that both the self‐ and cross‐fundamentals play important roles in prediction. Furthermore, according to our prediction, we obtain meaningful investment profit trading on currencies and bonds.
abstract_zh: 本文提出将“自身基本面”（定义为货币对中两个经济体的基本面）与“交叉基本面”（定义为其他主要经济体的基本面）相结合，以预测汇率，这与Berg和Mark（2015）提出的“第三国效应”理论一致。我们采用Hansen（2007）提出的Mallows模型平均方法，对基本面子模型提供的预测进行最优组合。研究发现，该方法在提前一个月的预测中显著优于随机游走模型及其他替代模型，且自身基本面与交叉基本面均在预测中发挥重要作用。此外，基于我们的预测，在货币和债券交易中可获得显著的投资利润。

title: Self‐Fundamentals, Cross‐Fundamentals, and Exchange Rate Predictions

abstract: We develop an open‐economy heterogeneous household model with incomplete markets to quantitatively evaluate the welfare and distributional effects—both within and across countries—of the corporate tax cut (Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, TCJA) implemented in the U.S. in 2017. The model allows for examining outcomes under various possibilities including the tax cut in the U.S. being permanent versus temporary and potential fiscal responses of other countries to the TCJA. We find that the TCJA is regressive in the U.S. and has relatively more regressive outcomes in other countries. Whether the wealth‐poor in the U.S. benefit from the TCJA or not depends on the persistence of the tax cut. Finally, when a small country reduces its corporate tax in response to the TCJA, it has a progressive distributional result in its own economy.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含不完全市场的开放经济异质性家庭模型，以定量评估2017年美国实施的企业减税政策（《减税与就业法案》，TCJA）在国内外产生的福利与分配效应。该模型允许考察多种情景下的结果，包括美国减税政策的永久性与临时性差异，以及其他国家可能采取的财政应对措施。研究发现：TCJA在美国具有累退性，且在其他国家产生了更显著的累退效应；美国财富匮乏群体能否从TCJA中获益取决于减税政策的持续性；当小国为应对TCJA而降低本国企业税率时，其国内将呈现累进性的分配结果。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: The Welfare and Distributional Consequences of Corporate Tax Cuts in Open Economies
title_zh: 开放经济中企业减税的福利与分配效应

abstract: We present evidence of a connection between bank concentration and labor markdown in China. Using a large dataset on bank branch distribution and firm performance in China, we document that financial friction in the local market leads to significantly higher firm-level labor markdowns but has little impact on firms’ product markup and profitability. This suggests that firms pass the impact of financial friction to the labor market by exploiting labor when faced with higher financial costs. Such transmission of financial friction is more salient among low-skill-intensity or non-state-owned firms, and greater labor mobility facilitates the transmission. Our findings highlight the distributional effect of financial friction in the economy: labor, especially the low-skilled ones, rather than capital, eventually bears the cost of financial friction.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了中国银行业集中度与劳动力市场买方垄断力之间关联的证据。利用中国银行分支机构分布与企业绩效的大型数据集，我们记录了本地市场金融摩擦导致企业层面劳动力买方垄断力显著提高，但对企业的产品加成率和盈利能力影响甚微。这表明，企业在面临更高财务成本时，通过剥削劳动力将金融摩擦的影响转嫁给劳动力市场。这种金融摩擦的传导在低技能密集度或非国有企业中更为显著，而更大的劳动力流动性促进了这一传导。我们的发现强调了金融摩擦在经济中的分配效应：劳动力，尤其是低技能劳动者，而非资本，最终承担了金融摩擦的成本。

abstract: Digital platforms may manipulate customer reviews to impede other consumers from acquiring accurate information and to increase sales. In a rational inattention setting where consumers acquire information about product quality before making purchasing decisions, we show that the platform has incentives to restrict information acquisition in the presence of consumers with wishful thinking. These biased consumers are unaware of their bias and weigh any good news about the product quality more heavily than a Bayesian consumer. We identify the conditions under which the firm optimally constrains information acquisition, and characterize when competition can alleviate this type of exploitation. Our results extend to a broader class of non-Bayesian rules beyond wishful thinking.
abstract_zh: 数字平台可能操纵客户评论，以阻碍其他消费者获取准确信息并提升销售额。在消费者购买决策前获取产品质量信息的理性疏忽框架下，我们证明，在存在一厢情愿思维的消费者时，平台有动机限制信息获取。这些有偏见的消费者未意识到自身偏见，并且对产品质量的任何好消息给予比贝叶斯消费者更重的权重。我们识别了企业最优限制信息获取的条件，并刻画了竞争何时能缓解此类剥削。我们的结果扩展至一厢情愿思维之外更广泛的非贝叶斯规则类别。
title: Information manipulation of wishful thinkers
title_zh: 一厢情愿者的信息操纵

abstract: We introduce a stylized model of an economy with occupational choice, income taxes, and tariffs. The government maximizes a utilitarian welfare function subject to a revenue requirement. In the small open economy (SOE) case, the government implements a free-trade policy, and either imposes a flat tax or a progressive tax on high-income entrepreneurs. In a closed-economy scenario, the government imposes a regressive tax on low-income workers while exempting (or subsidizing) high-income entrepreneurs. A transition from a closed economy to an SOE improves optimal income tax progressivity.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含职业选择、所得税与关税的简约经济模型。政府需在满足收入需求的前提下最大化功利主义社会福利函数。在小型开放经济体（SOE）情形下，政府实施自由贸易政策，并对高收入企业家征收统一税率或累进税。在封闭经济情境中，政府对低收入工人征收累退税，同时豁免（或补贴）高收入企业家。从封闭经济向小型开放经济体的转型，会提升最优所得税的累进性。
title: Optimal income taxes and tariffs in a small economy
title_zh: 小型经济体中的最优所得税与关税

abstract: Chamley and Judd argued that optimal taxation dictates zero long-run taxes on capital income, but Straub and Werning found that these taxes may be positive in the steady state. These models feature a ‘period-zero problem’ because the Ramsey formulation omits past commitments but includes future ones. Chari, Nicolini, and Teles (2020) add commitments to the representative household’s wealth in utility units. Then a nonzero capital levy may apply in period 1, future tax rates on asset income equal zero, and tax rates on consumption are constant. Time-consistency fails if future policymakers are unconstrained but holds if wealth commitments in each period are strict enough to motivate each policymaker to choose zero capital levies. Then a timeless perspective applies where period 1 is not special, tax rates on asset income are always zero, and tax rates on consumption are constant. In the neoclassical growth model with utility depending on the log of consumption, the level of the wealth commitment is constant in the steady state. Extensions allow for uncertainty and heterogeneity and for a form of partial commitment.
abstract_zh: Chamley与Judd认为最优税收理论要求资本收入长期税率为零，但Straub与Werning发现稳态下此类税收可能为正。这些模型存在"第零期问题"，因为拉姆齐框架忽略了历史承诺却包含未来承诺。Chari、Nicolini与Teles（2020）将代表性家庭以效用单位衡量的财富承诺纳入模型。此时第一期可能征收非零资本税，后续各期资产收入税率均为零，消费税率保持恒定。若未来政策制定者不受约束则时间一致性失效，但若每期财富承诺严格到足以激励每位政策制定者选择零资本税，则时间一致性成立。此时适用无时间视角：第一期不再特殊，资产收入税率始终为零，消费税率保持恒定。在消费对数效用的新古典增长模型中，稳态财富承诺水平保持恒定。该框架可扩展至包含不确定性、异质性及部分承诺形式。
title: Taxation of Capital–Capital Levies and Commitment
title_zh: 资本课税——资本征收与承诺

abstract: Corporate governance in microfinance institutions (MFIs) significantly influences their ability to pursue financial sustainability and social outreach, yet two decades of empirical research have produced fragmented and contradictory findings. This paper presents a systematic review of 47 peer-reviewed studies published between 2005 and 2025 that examine how governance mechanisms shape MFI dual performance. Rather than treating theoretical concentration and empirical inconsistency as symptoms of weak scholarship, we demonstrate that both reflect structural constraints embedded in prevailing data infrastructures. Widely used datasets, most prominently MIX Market, disproportionately support agency-theoretic constructs while rendering relational, institutional, and stakeholder governance dimensions largely unobservable, systematically shaping theory selection, empirical strategy, and reported findings across the literature. Building on these considerations, the review makes three contributions. First, it provides a structural explanation for why agency theory dominates the field and argues that theoretical diversification requires investment in richer data rather than simply broader lens selection. Second, it demonstrates that standard governance variables function as bundled proxies whose effects are contingent on organizational form, regulatory status, and stakeholder structure, and proposes simultaneous equations modeling to capture the feedback loops between financial performance and social outreach that single-equation designs cannot estimate. Third, it identifies informal and relational governance mechanisms, trust-based networks, board members’ social capital, and stakeholder embeddedness as theoretically central but empirically absent, and proposes longitudinal and mixed-method designs to address this blind spot. Together, these contributions reframe the research agenda on MFI governance and call for a redefinition of effective governance in hybrid, mission-driven organizations.
abstract_zh: 小额信贷机构（MFIs）的公司治理显著影响其追求财务可持续性与社会外展的能力，然而二十年的实证研究却产生了零散且相互矛盾的发现。本文对2005年至2025年间发表的47篇同行评审研究进行了系统性回顾，考察治理机制如何塑造MFI的双重绩效。我们并未将理论集中性与实证不一致视为学术薄弱的迹象，而是证明这两者均反映了现有数据基础设施中嵌入的结构性约束。广泛使用的数据集，尤其是MIX Market，不成比例地支持代理理论构建，同时使关系性、制度性和利益相关者治理维度在很大程度上不可观测，从而系统性地影响了整个文献中的理论选择、实证策略和报告结果。基于这些考量，本综述做出三项贡献。首先，它为代理理论为何主导该领域提供了结构性解释，并主张理论多样化需要投资于更丰富的数据，而非仅仅选择更广泛的视角。其次，它证明标准治理变量作为捆绑代理变量发挥作用，其效应取决于组织形式、监管状态和利益相关者结构，并提出联立方程建模以捕捉财务绩效与社会外展之间的反馈循环，这是单一方程设计无法估计的。第三，它识别出非正式和关系性治理机制、基于信任的网络、董事会成员的社会资本以及利益相关者嵌入性在理论上至关重要但在实证中缺失，并提出纵向和混合方法设计以解决这一盲点。综合来看，这些贡献重新构建了MFI治理的研究议程，并呼吁重新定义混合型、使命驱动型组织中有效治理的内涵。
title: Corporate governance in microfinance institutions: A systematic review of theoretical perspectives, methodological approaches, and empirical evidence
title_zh: 小额信贷机构的公司治理：理论视角、方法论与实证证据的系统综述

abstract: How did epidemic mortality affect housing wealth in the pre-industrial period? Using new data on house ownership and variation in street-level mortality in seventeenth-century Leiden, we show that although epidemic mortality targeted poor streets where residents were typically tenants and not owners, these outbreaks still increased the turnover of houses. Ordinarily, turnover was higher in owner-occupied housing sectors, while epidemics created more turnover for low-value houses consolidated in the hands of wealthy investors. In combination with a lack of house price adjustments due to rapid demographic recovery after epidemics, this meant that houses were passed between long-standing owners with similar housing wealth profiles. As a result, epidemics did not affect aggregate housing wealth inequality.
abstract_zh: 流行病死亡率如何影响前工业化时期的住房财富？利用关于房屋所有权的新数据以及十七世纪莱顿街道层面死亡率的变异，我们表明，尽管流行病死亡率主要针对贫困街道，那里的居民通常是租户而非业主，但这些疫情仍然增加了房屋的流转率。通常情况下，业主自住住房部门的流转率较高，而疫情则为集中在富裕投资者手中的低价值房屋带来了更多流转。结合疫情后人口迅速恢复导致房价缺乏调整的情况，这意味着房屋在具有相似住房财富特征的老业主之间传递。因此，疫情并未影响总体住房财富不平等。
title: Epidemic mortality and redistribution of housing wealth in Leiden, 1632–1668
title_zh: 1632–1668年莱顿流行病死亡率与住房财富再分配
